text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
...Was it because... I was too 
overconfident—? Thinking that—I could do 
it—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
"...Discounted deli food. —Finishing it 
all was fine, but— My stomach—hurts—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Unable to turn a blind eye to the unsold 
leftovers, Symboli Kris S had pushed 
herself too far.
